package abt

import (
	"math"
	"testing"

	"gno.land/p/nt/uassert/v0"
	"gno.land/r/akkadia/beta/admin"
)

func TestInitialState(t *testing.T) {
	uassert.Equal(t, "Akkadia Beta Token", GetName())
	uassert.Equal(t, "abt", GetSymbol())
	uassert.Equal(t, 6, GetDecimals())
	uassert.Equal(t, "gno.land/r/akkadia/beta/abt.abt.0000000", token.ID())
	uassert.True(t, IsFrozen())
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), TotalSupply())
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), BalanceOf(abtTest.Owner))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), Allowance(abtTest.Owner, abtTest.Other))
}

func TestMintWhileFrozen(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	setupABT(cross(cur), t)
	for _, caller := range []address{abtTest.Admin, abtTest.Operator} {
		testing.SetOriginCaller(caller)
		testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(caller))
		Mint(cross(cur), abtTest.Owner, 100)
		Mint(cross(cur), abtTest.Other, 10)
	}
	uassert.True(t, IsFrozen())
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(220), TotalSupply())
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(200), BalanceOf(abtTest.Owner))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(20), BalanceOf(abtTest.Other))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), Allowance(abtTest.Owner, abtTest.Other))
}

func TestMintInvalidInput(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	cases := []struct {
		name     string
		to       address
		amount   int64
		panicMsg string
	}{
		{"empty address", address(""), 1, "invalid abt recipient"},
		{"invalid address", address("invalid"), 1, "invalid abt recipient"},
		{"zero", abtTest.Owner, 0, "abt amount must be positive"},
		{"negative", abtTest.Owner, -1, "abt amount must be positive"},
		{"minimum int64", abtTest.Owner, math.MinInt64, "abt amount must be positive"},
	}
	for _, tc := range cases {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
			setupABT(cross(cur), t)
			testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(abtTest.Admin))
			Mint(cross(cur), abtTest.Owner, 7)
			uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, tc.panicMsg, func() {
				Mint(cross(cur), tc.to, tc.amount)
			})
			uassert.Equal(t, int64(7), TotalSupply())
			uassert.Equal(t, int64(7), BalanceOf(abtTest.Owner))
			uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), BalanceOf(abtTest.Other))
		})
	}
}

func TestMintOverflow(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	setupABT(cross(cur), t)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(abtTest.Admin))
	Mint(cross(cur), abtTest.Owner, math.MaxInt64)
	for _, to := range []address{abtTest.Owner, abtTest.Other} {
		uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "abt mint failed: mint overflow", func() {
			Mint(cross(cur), to, 1)
		})
	}
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(math.MaxInt64), TotalSupply())
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(math.MaxInt64), BalanceOf(abtTest.Owner))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), BalanceOf(abtTest.Other))
}

func TestFreezeLifecycle(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	setupABT(cross(cur), t)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(abtTest.Admin))
	Mint(cross(cur), abtTest.Owner, 100)
	SetFrozen(cross(cur), true)
	SetFrozen(cross(cur), false)
	SetFrozen(cross(cur), false)
	Mint(cross(cur), abtTest.Owner, 5)
	testing.SetOriginCaller(abtTest.Owner)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(abtTest.Owner))
	Transfer(cross(cur), abtTest.Other, 10)
	Approve(cross(cur), abtTest.Other, 40)
	testing.SetOriginCaller(abtTest.Other)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(abtTest.Other))
	TransferFrom(cross(cur), abtTest.Owner, abtTest.Admin, 15)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(80), BalanceOf(abtTest.Owner))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(10), BalanceOf(abtTest.Other))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(15), BalanceOf(abtTest.Admin))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(25), Allowance(abtTest.Owner, abtTest.Other))
	testing.SetOriginCaller(abtTest.Admin)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(abtTest.Admin))
	SetFrozen(cross(cur), true)
	testing.SetOriginCaller(abtTest.Owner)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(abtTest.Owner))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "abt is frozen", func() { Approve(cross(cur), abtTest.Other, 0) })
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "abt is frozen", func() { Transfer(cross(cur), abtTest.Other, 1) })
	testing.SetOriginCaller(abtTest.Other)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(abtTest.Other))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "abt is frozen", func() {
		TransferFrom(cross(cur), abtTest.Owner, abtTest.Admin, 25)
	})
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(25), Allowance(abtTest.Owner, abtTest.Other))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(80), BalanceOf(abtTest.Owner))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(105), TotalSupply())
	testing.SetOriginCaller(abtTest.Admin)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(abtTest.Admin))
	SetFrozen(cross(cur), false)
	testing.SetOriginCaller(abtTest.Other)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(abtTest.Other))
	TransferFrom(cross(cur), abtTest.Owner, abtTest.Admin, 25)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), Allowance(abtTest.Owner, abtTest.Other))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(55), BalanceOf(abtTest.Owner))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(40), BalanceOf(abtTest.Admin))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(105), TotalSupply())
	testing.SetOriginCaller(abtTest.Owner)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(abtTest.Owner))
	Approve(cross(cur), abtTest.Other, 5)
	Approve(cross(cur), abtTest.Other, 7)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(7), Allowance(abtTest.Owner, abtTest.Other))
	Approve(cross(cur), abtTest.Other, 0)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), Allowance(abtTest.Owner, abtTest.Other))
}

func TestMintRoleChanges(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	setupABT(cross(cur), t)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(abtTest.Admin))
	admin.UnsetOperator(cross(cur), abtTest.Operator)
	testing.SetOriginCaller(abtTest.Operator)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(abtTest.Operator))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "admin or operator access required", func() { Mint(cross(cur), abtTest.Owner, 1) })
	testing.SetOriginCaller(abtTest.Admin)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(abtTest.Admin))
	admin.TransferAdmin(cross(cur), abtTest.Other)
	testing.SetOriginCaller(abtTest.Other)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(abtTest.Other))
	admin.AcceptAdmin(cross(cur))
	Mint(cross(cur), abtTest.Owner, 3)
	SetFrozen(cross(cur), false)
	testing.SetOriginCaller(abtTest.Admin)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(abtTest.Admin))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "admin or operator access required", func() { Mint(cross(cur), abtTest.Owner, 1) })
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "admin access required", func() { SetFrozen(cross(cur), true) })
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(3), TotalSupply())
	uassert.False(t, IsFrozen())
}

func TestExternalWrapperLifecycle(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	caller := testutils.TestAddress("abtExternalAdmin")
	owner := testutils.TestAddress("abtExternalOwner")
	other := testutils.TestAddress("abtExternalOther")
	testing.SetOriginCaller(admin.GetAdmin())
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(admin.GetAdmin()))
	admin.TransferAdmin(cross(cur), caller)
	testing.SetOriginCaller(caller)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(caller))
	admin.AcceptAdmin(cross(cur))
	testing.SetOriginSend(chain.Coins{})
	testing.SetRealm(runtime.NewRealm(caller, "gno.land/e/"+caller.String()+"/run"))
	abt.SetFrozen(cross(cur), true)
	supplyBefore := abt.TotalSupply()
	abt.Mint(cross(cur), owner, 20)
	uassert.Equal(t, "Akkadia Beta Token", abt.GetName())
	uassert.Equal(t, "abt", abt.GetSymbol())
	uassert.Equal(t, 6, abt.GetDecimals())
	uassert.Equal(t, supplyBefore+20, abt.TotalSupply())
	uassert.True(t, abt.IsFrozen())
	abt.SetFrozen(cross(cur), false)
	testing.SetOriginCaller(owner)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(owner))
	abt.Transfer(cross(cur), other, 2)
	abt.Approve(cross(cur), other, 5)
	testing.SetOriginCaller(other)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(other))
	abt.TransferFrom(cross(cur), owner, other, 3)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(15), abt.BalanceOf(owner))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(5), abt.BalanceOf(other))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(2), abt.Allowance(owner, other))
	uassert.Equal(t, "15", abt.Render("balance/"+owner.String()))
	// A later failing transfer must preserve allowance even if its abort is caught.
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "abt transfer failed: cannot send transfer to self", func() {
		abt.TransferFrom(cross(cur), owner, owner, 1)
	})
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(2), abt.Allowance(owner, other))
	testing.SetOriginCaller(caller)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(caller))
	abt.SetFrozen(cross(cur), true)
	testing.SetOriginCaller(other)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(other))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "abt is frozen", func() { abt.TransferFrom(cross(cur), owner, other, 2) })
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(2), abt.Allowance(owner, other))
	uassert.Equal(t, supplyBefore+20, abt.TotalSupply())
}

import (

func TestUnauthorizedMintAndFreeze(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	setupABT(cross(cur), t)
	testing.SetOriginCaller(abtTest.Owner)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(abtTest.Owner))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "admin or operator access required", func() { Mint(cross(cur), abtTest.Owner, 1) })
	for _, caller := range []address{abtTest.Owner, abtTest.Operator} {
		testing.SetOriginCaller(caller)
		testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(caller))
		for _, value := range []bool{true, false} {
			uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "admin access required", func() { SetFrozen(cross(cur), value) })
		}
	}
	for _, signer := range []address{abtTest.Admin, abtTest.Operator} {
		testing.SetOriginCaller(signer)
		testing.SetRealm(testing.NewCodeRealm("gno.land/r/example/abt_relay"))
		uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "admin or operator access required", func() { Mint(cross(cur), abtTest.Owner, 1) })
		uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "admin access required", func() { SetFrozen(cross(cur), false) })
	}
	uassert.True(t, IsFrozen())
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), TotalSupply())
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), BalanceOf(abtTest.Owner))
}

func TestFrozenRejectsAllCallers(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	setupABT(cross(cur), t)
	for _, caller := range []address{abtTest.Admin, abtTest.Operator, abtTest.Owner} {
		testing.SetOriginCaller(abtTest.Admin)
		testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(abtTest.Admin))
		Mint(cross(cur), caller, 10)
		testing.SetOriginCaller(caller)
		testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(caller))
		uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "abt is frozen", func() { Transfer(cross(cur), abtTest.Other, 1) })
		uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "abt is frozen", func() { Approve(cross(cur), abtTest.Other, 1) })
		uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "abt is frozen", func() { Approve(cross(cur), abtTest.Other, 0) })
		uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "abt is frozen", func() { TransferFrom(cross(cur), caller, abtTest.Other, 1) })
		uassert.Equal(t, int64(10), BalanceOf(caller))
		uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), Allowance(caller, abtTest.Other))
	}
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(30), TotalSupply())
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), BalanceOf(abtTest.Other))

func TestAttachedCoinsRejected(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	cases := []struct {
		name string
		call func(_ int, rlm realm)
	}{
		{"mint", func(_ int, rlm realm) { Mint(cross(rlm), abtTest.Owner, 1) }},
		{"freeze", func(_ int, rlm realm) { SetFrozen(cross(rlm), true) }},
		{"freeze no-op", func(_ int, rlm realm) { SetFrozen(cross(rlm), false) }},
		{"transfer", func(_ int, rlm realm) { Transfer(cross(rlm), abtTest.Other, 1) }},
		{"approve", func(_ int, rlm realm) { Approve(cross(rlm), abtTest.Other, 1) }},
		{"transferFrom", func(_ int, rlm realm) { TransferFrom(cross(rlm), abtTest.Owner, abtTest.Other, 1) }},
	}
	for _, tc := range cases {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(cur realm, t *testing.T) {

			testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(abtTest.Admin))
			Mint(cross(cur), abtTest.Admin, 10)
			SetFrozen(cross(cur), false)
			for _, caller := range []runtime.Realm{
				testing.NewUserRealm(abtTest.Admin),
				runtime.NewRealm(abtTest.Admin, "gno.land/e/"+abtTest.Admin.String()+"/run"),
			} {
				testing.SetRealm(caller)
				testing.SetOriginSend(chain.Coins{{"ugnot", 1}})
				uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "attached coins not allowed", func() { tc.call(0, cur) })
				uassert.False(t, IsFrozen())
				uassert.Equal(t, int64(10), TotalSupply())
				uassert.Equal(t, int64(10), BalanceOf(abtTest.Admin))
				uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), BalanceOf(abtTest.Other))
				uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), Allowance(abtTest.Admin, abtTest.Other))
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestRelayUsesOwnBalanceAndAllowance(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	setupABT(cross(cur), t)
	relay := testing.NewCodeRealm("gno.land/r/example/abt_relay")
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(abtTest.Admin))
	Mint(cross(cur), abtTest.Owner, 100)
	Mint(cross(cur), relay.Address(), 20)
	SetFrozen(cross(cur), false)
	testing.SetOriginCaller(abtTest.Owner)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(abtTest.Owner))
	Approve(cross(cur), relay.Address(), 7)
	Approve(cross(cur), abtTest.Owner, 30)
	// These coins belong to the relay's origin call, not to ABT.
	testing.SetOriginSend(chain.Coins{{"ugnot", 1}})
	testing.SetRealm(relay)
	Transfer(cross(cur), abtTest.Other, 5)
	Approve(cross(cur), abtTest.Other, 3)
	TransferFrom(cross(cur), abtTest.Owner, abtTest.Other, 7)
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "abt transfer failed: insufficient allowance", func() {
		TransferFrom(cross(cur), abtTest.Owner, abtTest.Other, 1)
	})
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(93), BalanceOf(abtTest.Owner))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(15), BalanceOf(relay.Address()))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(12), BalanceOf(abtTest.Other))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(3), Allowance(relay.Address(), abtTest.Other))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), Allowance(abtTest.Owner, abtTest.Other))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), Allowance(abtTest.Owner, relay.Address()))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(30), Allowance(abtTest.Owner, abtTest.Owner))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(120), TotalSupply())
	testing.SetOriginSend(chain.Coins{})
	testing.SetOriginCaller(abtTest.Admin)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(abtTest.Admin))
	SetFrozen(cross(cur), true)
	testing.SetRealm(relay)
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "abt is frozen", func() { Transfer(cross(cur), abtTest.Other, 1) })
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "abt is frozen", func() { Approve(cross(cur), abtTest.Other, 0) })
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "abt is frozen", func() { TransferFrom(cross(cur), abtTest.Owner, abtTest.Other, 1) })
}

func TestOperatorRealmCanMintWithOwnAuthority(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	setupABT(cross(cur), t)
	relay := testing.NewCodeRealm("gno.land/r/example/abt_operator")
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(abtTest.Admin))
	admin.SetOperator(cross(cur), relay.Address())
	testing.SetOriginCaller(abtTest.Owner)
	testing.SetOriginSend(chain.Coins{{"ugnot", 1}})

	uassert.True(t, IsFrozen())
}

	setupABT(cross(cur), t)

	uassert.True(t, IsFrozen())

package game_vault

import "strconv"

// ListRefundScopeStates returns participation process and reward pool states for refund decisions.
func ListRefundScopeStates(scopeKeys ...string) []map[string]string {
	if len(scopeKeys)%2 != 0 {
		panic("refund scope key count mismatch")
	}
	if len(scopeKeys)/2 > gameVaultList {
		panic("count exceeds game vault list limit")
	}

	result := []map[string]string{}
	for index := 0; index < len(scopeKeys); index += 2 {
		processKey := scopeKeys[index]
		rewardPoolKey := scopeKeys[index+1]
		assertKeyLength(processKey, "process key")
		assertKeyLength(rewardPoolKey, "pool key")

		state := map[string]string{
			"requestedProcessKey":    processKey,
			"requestedRewardPoolKey": rewardPoolKey,
			"processId":              "0",
			"processKey":             "",
			"processGameWorldId":     "0",
			"processRewardPoolKey":   "",
			"participationFee":       "0",
			"processStatus":          "0",
			"rewardPoolId":           "0",
			"rewardPoolKey":          "",
			"rewardPoolGameWorldId":  "0",
			"rewardPoolStatus":       "0",
		}

		processID := GetParticipationProcessID(processKey)
		if processID != 0 {
			process := GetParticipationProcess(processID)
			state["processId"] = strconv.FormatUint(process.ID, 10)
			state["processKey"] = process.ProcessKey
			state["processGameWorldId"] = strconv.FormatUint(process.GameWorldID, 10)
			state["processRewardPoolKey"] = GetRewardPool(process.RewardPoolID).PoolKey
			state["participationFee"] = strconv.FormatInt(process.ParticipationFee, 10)
			state["processStatus"] = strconv.Itoa(int(process.Status))
		}

		rewardPoolID := GetRewardPoolID(rewardPoolKey)
		if rewardPoolID != 0 {
			pool := GetRewardPool(rewardPoolID)
			state["rewardPoolId"] = strconv.FormatUint(pool.ID, 10)
			state["rewardPoolKey"] = pool.PoolKey
			state["rewardPoolGameWorldId"] = strconv.FormatUint(pool.GameWorldID, 10)
			state["rewardPoolStatus"] = strconv.Itoa(int(pool.Status))
		}

		result = append(result, state)
	}
	return result
}

// ListParticipationRefundStates returns fund, processed operation, and refund evidence for each participant.
func ListParticipationRefundStates(values ...string) []map[string]string {
	if len(values)%4 != 0 {
		panic("participation refund value count mismatch")
	}
	if len(values)/4 > gameVaultList {
		panic("count exceeds game vault list limit")
	}

	result := []map[string]string{}
	for index := 0; index < len(values); index += 4 {
		processID, err := strconv.ParseUint(values[index], 10, 64)
		if err != nil || processID == 0 {
			panic("invalid participation process id")
		}
		owner := address(values[index+1])
		paymentKey := values[index+2]
		operationKey := values[index+3]
		assertValidOwner(owner)
		assertKeyLength(paymentKey, "payment key")
		assertKeyLength(operationKey, "operation key")

		state := map[string]string{
			"processId":           strconv.FormatUint(processID, 10),
			"owner":               owner.String(),
			"paymentKey":          paymentKey,
			"operationKey":        operationKey,
			"fundId":              "0",
			"fundProcessId":       "0",
			"participationKey":    "",
			"fundPaymentKey":      "",
			"fundOwner":           "",
			"fundAmount":          "0",

			state["refundKind"] = refund.Kind
		}

		result = append(result, state)
	}
	return result
}

	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(listed, "Total**: 2"), "should render the owned token count")
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(listed, "test\\-iron"), "should escape item token ids")
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(listed, "**: 3"), "should render item amounts")
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(listed, `\*\*x\*\*`), "escaped markdown token id should be visible")
